tasks.PreventDrivingCarTask1: Check if the car has experienced an automobile accident that could have damaged its components or systems.
tasks.PreventDrivingCarTask2: Assess whether the driver is experiencing a backache which might prevent them from operating the vehicle safely.
tasks.PreventDrivingCarTask3: Evaluate if there's low fuel in the tank, as this would prevent the car from continuing to drive.
tasks.PreventDrivingCarTask4: Determine if pollution or smoke are present and could be affecting the car’s ability to continue driving.
